items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: After I left Charlie Cook, I went with Earl. And Earl is about the last band that is working regularly that I worked with.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. What were your last jobs about? I didn't cover all of that last part of your life when you... Like after you'd made the records with Jolly Roll Martin, we talked quite a while about that. I wondered after that period which band you were with. You mentioned Hines. Uh-huh.

Oh, yes. Well... Dickerson, others. Well, now after that, let's see, Dickerson and Charlie Cook. Now, I worked with Charlie Cook several times. I've... See, I think I went back with Dickerson, and then was back with Charlie Cook. See, I've moved them on those jobs several times. And then, uh, let's see, where else was it? I can't think of who I worked with before I went with Earl. I think it was Charlie. After I left Charlie Cook, I went with Earl. And Earl is about the last band that is working regularly that I…
You were in the WPA band there for a while, wasn't it?
